raft.idle: Ready to propose a new entry.
raft.appended: The leader has appended entry 1 in the current term. It is not committed yet.
raft.acknowledged: Follower A has acknowledged entry 1. With the leader, a majority of 2/3 has replicated it.
raft.committed: The leader advances commitIndex to 1, then notifies followers. Follower B catches up.
raft.assumptions: Conceptual model: fixed leader, one current-term entry, three healthy nodes. Elections, disk persistence, retries, and network failures are omitted. This is not a running HyperRaft cluster.

aboutPage.title:
The people behind
the foundations.
aboutPage.metaDescription: Learn about Smartscity, its company identity, software engineering focus, projects, and official contact channels.
aboutPage.intro: Smartscity — Biying Technology — is a technology brand focused on software engineering, distributed infrastructure, engineering quality, and developer productivity.
aboutPage.whoText: We develop software around two connected needs: dependable foundations for applications, and useful tools for the people who build and use them. Our work spans consensus and replication concepts, integration-testing quality, Markdown workflows, and vocabulary learning.
aboutPage.whoText2: This website introduces our work and provides routes to project documentation, public source code, and releases where available. Each project page distinguishes published capabilities from concepts that do not yet have public implementation evidence.
aboutPage.projectsIntro: Explore the existing project introductions, technical concepts, and public repositories. Availability and capabilities are described on each project page.
aboutPage.openSourceText: Share source and documentation where projects are public, welcome specific questions, and keep claims connected to evidence.
aboutPage.contactText: For company information, business inquiries, or questions about our work, use our official contact page.

contactPage.title:

starts with a clear question.
contactPage.metaDescription: Contact Smartscity for company, business, open-source, and privacy inquiries through its official channels.
contactPage.intro: Get in touch about Smartscity, its software projects, or a potential collaboration. Choose the channel that fits your question.
contactPage.businessText: For questions about the company, its software work, or a possible collaboration, email us with a short description and the relevant project, if any.
contactPage.businessFallback: Explore our official GitHub organization to find the relevant project and its published contact routes.
contactPage.openSourceText: For reproducible bugs, feature proposals, or contributions, start with the relevant public repository and its contribution guidance. Include the project version and a clear description, and keep private information out of public issues.
contactPage.privacyText: For questions about information handled through this website or a message you have sent us, use the official email below. Avoid sending passwords, identity documents, or other sensitive material in an initial inquiry.
contactPage.deliveryNote: Email links open your email application. This site has no contact form and does not send a message on your behalf.

privacyExtra.metaDescription: How the Smartscity website uses local storage, handles demonstrations and contact links, and relies on hosting providers.

sections.title: Website features and local storage
sections.text: The website application does not set advertising or analytics cookies and does not include visitor analytics. It stores only your selected color theme in browser local storage. You can remove that preference through your browser settings. Interactive examples keep sample inputs in page memory; they are not saved or sent to a server.

sections.title: Hosting and external services
sections.text: The site is hosted on Cloudflare. Hosting and security services may process request information, such as IP addresses and browser information, to deliver and protect the site. The application does not embed external forms, videos, or third-party tracking scripts. Its images, scripts, styles, and fonts are served locally or supplied by your device.

sections.title: Email and public project links
sections.text: There is no contact form on this website. A mailto link opens your email application; sending a message is your separate action. If you email us, your message and the contact information you choose to provide reach the receiving mailbox. GitHub links take you to GitHub, where its own privacy policy applies. Do not post confidential information in public issues.

privacyExtra.contactText: Contact us through the official channel listed on our Contact page.
